{"path": "lib/tablefmt.rb", "content": "# Plain-text tables.
class TableFmt
  ALIGNMENTS = %i[left right center].freeze

  attr_reader :headers, :rows

  def initialize(headers)
    @headers = headers.map(&:to_s)
    @rows = []
    @align = {}
  end

  def <<(row)
    raise ArgumentError, "expected #{@headers.size} cells, got #{row.size}" unless row.size == @headers.size

    @rows << row.map(&:to_s)
    self
  end

  # Set per-column alignment. Keys are header names, values :left, :right or :center.
  def align(spec)
    spec.each do |name, value|
      unless @headers.include?(name.to_s)
        raise KeyError, "unknown column: #{name.inspect}"
      end
      unless ALIGNMENTS.include?(value)
        raise ArgumentError, "unknown alignment: #{value.inspect}"
      end
      @align[name.to_s] = value
    end
    self
  end

  # Width of each column: the max of the header and all cell strings.
  def widths
    @headers.each_index.map do |i|
      (@headers[i].size + @rows.map { |r| r[i].size }).max
    end
  end

  # Render as a plain-text table. With max_width:, cells wider than the limit
  # are truncated with a trailing ellipsis.
  def to_s(max_width: nil)
    widths = self.widths
    lines = [render_row(@headers, widths, max_width)]
    lines << widths.map { |w| '-' * w }.join(' ')
    @rows.each { |row| lines << render_row(row, widths, max_width) }
    lines.join("\n")
  end

  # Render as a GitHub-flavoured markdown table.
  def to_markdown
    widths = self.widths
    lines = [render_md_row(@headers, widths)]
    lines << widths.map { |w| md_separator(w) }.join('|')
    @rows.each { |row| lines << render_md_row(row, widths) }
    lines.join("\n")
  end

  # Sort rows in place by the column named +name+ (or by the block).
  # Returns self so calls can be chained.
  def sort_by!(name = nil, &block)
    if name
      i = @headers.index(name.to_s)
      raise KeyError, "unknown column: #{name.inspect}" unless i

      block = ->(row) { row[i] }
    end
    @rows.sort_by!(&block)
    self
  end

  private

  def render_row(cells, widths, max_width)
    cells.each_with_index.map do |cell, i|
      cell = truncate(cell, max_width) if max_width
      pad(cell, widths[i], @align[@headers[i]] || :left)
    end.join(' ')
  end

  def render_md_row(cells, widths)
    cells.each_with_index.map do |cell, i|
      cell = cell.gsub('|', '\\|')
      " #{pad(cell, widths[i], @align[@headers[i]] || :left)} "
    end.join('|')
  end

  def md_separator(width)
    case @align[@headers[0]] || :left
    when :right then ' ' + '-' * (width - 1) + ':'
    when :center then ':' + '-' * (width - 2) + ':'
    else ':' + '-' * (width - 1) + ' '
    end
  end

  def pad(cell, width, alignment)
    case alignment
    when :right then cell.rjust(width)
    when :center then cell.center(width)
    else cell.ljust(width)
    end
  end

  def truncate(cell, max_width)
    return cell if cell.size <= max_width

    cell[0...max_width] + '…'
  end
end
